items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Well sometimes I had Brew Moore, and sometimes Coleman Hawkins.

ctx.x: What kinds of were yo working with when you were a leader at Birdland? What kind of personnel did you have? Do you remember?

Yeah, we worked... Well sometimes I had Brew Moore, and sometimes Coleman Hawkins. If Hawk didn't have me, I'd just say I worked with him, because he worked for me a couple of times. Not too many different type of... I would use Wardell and Teddy Edwards if they were here.
